entry_points.summary: Haiku subagent definition: role, procedure, output contract, hard rules, slug anti-patterns
Full input field list: parent_command, debug_md_path, artifact primacy rules by parent_command
Six-step candidate generation: read artifacts, scan signals, prefer existing slugs, cap at 3, check tags, debug filter
Fenced JSON schema for candidate objects; any other output treated as malformed
Skip-condition guard and artifact-prep helper; called before every review-agent dispatch
Skip condition: fires when parent_command=debug and DEBUG.md is absent or unreadable
Emits AXIOM_READY <diff_path> on STATUS:ready unless Z_HARNESS_AXIOM_EXTRACT=0
Orchestrator Phase 9: helper call, skip handling, agent dispatch, parse, accept/skip loop
Orchestrator Phase 7: same as Phase 9 but without all_tasks_skipped skip condition
Orchestrator Phase 10 (shipped branch only): debug_md_path as primary artifact; AXIOM_READY dispatches axiom-extractor in parallel

invariants: subagent never writes; orchestrator owns all writes
skip-conditions check via run-memory-review.sh before any Agent dispatch (cost guard)
hard cap of 3 candidates per run; emit fewer rather than pad
output is exactly one fenced json block; any other output is malformed
agent receives index_path and must prefer extending an existing slug over coining a new one
when parent_command=debug, debug_md_path is primary artifact; spec_path is supplementary only
memory_review_terminal event emitted at terminal state of every review pass regardless of path taken
review_agent_failed and review_agent_malformed do NOT emit memory_review_terminal; they are orthogonal failure classes
AXIOM_READY line is emitted by run-memory-review.sh on STATUS:ready unless Z_HARNESS_AXIOM_EXTRACT=0; orchestrators must scan all output lines for the prefix
gotchas: run-memory-review.sh requires $Z_HARNESS_PLAN_DIR to be set; unset yields STATUS: skipped no_plan_dir
run-memory-review.sh soft-skips (exit 0) on missing TAGS.txt rather than failing hard; emits skipped_broken_context state
when parent_command=debug, line 5 of helper stdout is DEBUG.md path; LINES[4] in orchestrator
AXIOM_READY line appears after all artifact paths; orchestrators must scan by prefix not fixed line index
debug_md_missing skip fires when DEBUG.md absent — distinct from empty_diff skip
abandoned debug sessions never invoke run-memory-review.sh; no telemetry emitted
empty diff causes skip with skip_reason: empty_diff before any Agent dispatch
diff base ref resolved in order: merge-base(origin/main) -> HEAD~5 -> empty-tree
parse failure on agent return is a soft-skip (review_agent_malformed event) not a hard error
subagent timeout has no per-call wall-clock guard in v1; user ctrl-c is the escape
candidate tags must come from docs/llm/TAGS.txt unless free-form is explicitly justified
review_agent_suggest_failed is logged and skipped (iteration continues) — not a phase abort
skills/z-implement-all/SKILL.md, skills/z-review-all/SKILL.md, skills/z-debug/SKILL.md are canonical; commands/ may be stale
z-implement-all and z-review-all do not currently parse AXIOM_READY; only z-debug Phase 10 dispatches axiom-extractor
